lines: Kulakuṇḍalinī having bound, within the atom unconscious; left which this in this universe of him intent on withdrawal.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kulakuṇḍalikāṃ baddhvā aṇorantaravedinīm vāmo yo@yaṃ jagatyasmiṃstasya saṃharaṇodyatām
